KVK (Dutch Chamber of Commerce) — "Eenmanszaak uitschrijven", consulted 2026-08-06. Official guidance on deregistering a sole proprietorship from the Handelsregister: the deregistration is done online via Mijn KVK with DigiD, is free, and is definitive; the owner must keep filing tax returns until the Belastingdienst confirms otherwise; and KVK itself forwards the deregistration to the Belastingdienst rather than the owner having to notify them separately. The eenmanszaak side of the winding-up fork (§5b's "how to wind up cleanly" chapter-28 subject).

KVK — "Een rechtspersoon beëindigen via de turboliquidatie", "Bijgewerkt" (updated) 2026-08-04, consulted 2026-08-06. Official guidance on the fast-track dissolution route for a bv (and other legal persons): usable only when there are no baten (assets) left at the moment of dissolution, with an explicit warning that the definition of baten is broader than owners expect; since the tijdelijke wet Transparantie turboliquidatie (15 November 2023), the board must file financial accounting documents with KVK within fourteen days of the dissolution resolution, and can face personal liability or a bestuursverbod (director's disqualification) for misuse. The bv side of the winding-up fork, and the source for why "just stop" is not in fact simple for an incorporated business.

Rijksoverheid — "Aanpak schijnzelfstandigheid" (Ministerie van SZW), consulted 2026-08-28. Government page stating that the Belastingdienst has enforced fully against schijnzelfstandigheid again since 2025-01-01, the charges an employer pays after the fact (loonbelasting, premies werknemersverzekeringen, bijdragen Zvw, sometimes pension), and that client and zzp'er share responsibility for the correct contract.
